newsitem.title: UK: UK s/adj M0 rises to 24.717 bln stg in latest week.
newsitem.headline: UK s/adj M0 rises to 24.717 bln stg in latest week.

text.p: UK M0 money supply rose to 24.717 billion stg, on a seasonally adjusted basis, in the week to November 13, the Bank of England said on Monday.
The week before, the narrow money supply measure totalled 24.682 billion stg.
Notes and coins in circulation edged up to 24.575 billion stg, from 24.482 billion, on a seasonally adjusted basis.

The unadjusted level for M0 was 24.504 billion stg in the week ending November 13, down from 24.540 billion the previous week. Unadjusted notes and coins in circulation totalled 24.362 billion stg, up from 24.340 billion.
